# Grammar patterns, Chapters 1–15

This index follows the textbook contents and grammar notes. References show printed book pages and scanned PDF pages. Explanations are paraphrased; textbook examples are omitted.

## Chapter 1

- **要 + verb** — `要 + 动词`: expresses a wish or intention; its usual negative is 不想. (pp. 4–5; PDF 24–25)
- **最** — `最 + adjective / verb`: marks the highest degree or preference within a relevant set. (p. 4; PDF 24)
- **Approximate counts: 几, 多** — 几 precedes a classifier for an indefinite small count. 多 follows the classifier with numerals under ten and precedes it with numerals of ten or more. (pp. 4–5; PDF 24–25)

## Chapter 2

- **是不是 questions** — `是不是 + predicate` or sentence-final `是不是?`: seeks confirmation of an expectation. (p. 12; PDF 32)
- **每** — `每 + classifier (+ 都)`: means each/every member of a set; 都 often follows. (p. 12; PDF 32)
- **多 degree questions** — `多 + adjective?`: asks about degree; answer with a quantity or measurement. (p. 12; PDF 32)

## Chapter 3

- **的 phrases** — `pronoun / adjective / verb phrase + 的`: forms a noun phrase when its head noun is understood. (p. 20; PDF 40)
- **一下** — `verb + 一下`: presents an action as brief or light; the object may be omitted. (p. 20; PDF 40)
- **真** — `真 + adjective`: adds emphatic or exclamatory force. (p. 20; PDF 40)

## Chapter 4

- **是……的, emphasizing the agent** — `(object) + 是 + agent + verb + 的`: identifies or emphasizes the performer of an established event; negate with 不 before 是. (p. 28; PDF 48)
- **的时候** — `time expression / verb phrase + 的时候`: introduces a time when something occurs. (p. 28; PDF 48)
- **已经** — `已经 + predicate (+ 了)`: marks an action as completed or a state as already attained. (p. 29; PDF 49)

## Chapter 5

- **就 as a conclusion** — `context, 就 + verb phrase`: introduces a decision or conclusion based on preceding information. (p. 36; PDF 56)
- **还 as a qualified evaluation** — `还 + adjective`: means acceptable or passable. (p. 36; PDF 56)
- **有点儿** — `有点儿 + adjective / verb`: indicates a degree often viewed negatively or with mild dissatisfaction. (p. 36; PDF 56)

## Chapter 6

- **怎么 asking why** — `怎么 + verb / adjective?`: asks why, often conveying surprise. (p. 44; PDF 64)
- **Reduplicated classifiers** — `classifier + classifier (+ 都)`: means every member in a set; 都 commonly follows. (p. 44; PDF 64)
- **因为……所以……** — `因为 + cause, (所以) + result`: links cause and result; one conjunction may be omitted. (pp. 44–45; PDF 64–65)

## Chapter 7

- **还 as continuation** — `还 + verb / adjective`; negative `还没 + verb`: marks an ongoing action or state. (p. 52; PDF 72)
- **就 for early or quick occurrence** — `time / context + 就 + predicate`: emphasizes that an event happens early, quickly, or smoothly. (p. 52; PDF 72)
- **离** — `place / time / purpose + 离 + reference point`: expresses distance from a place, time, or purpose. (p. 52; PDF 72)
- **呢** — sentence-final 呢 can indicate an ongoing situation or prompt a response about an established topic. (p. 52; PDF 72)

## Chapter 8

- **……好吗?** — Add 好吗? to a proposal or request to ask for the listener's view or agreement. (p. 60; PDF 80)
- **再** — `再 + verb phrase`: marks repetition, continuation, or a later action under a stated circumstance. (p. 60; PDF 80)
- **Pivotal sentences** — `verb₁ + noun/pronoun + verb₂`: the first verb's object is also the understood subject of the second verb. (p. 60; PDF 80)
- **Verb reduplication** — `V → VV / V一V`; disyllabic verbs can use `ABAB`: presents an action as brief, slight, limited, or attempted. (p. 61; PDF 81)

## Chapter 9

- **Result complements** — `verb + result complement`: states an action's result. Negation uses 没(有) before the verb and omits sentence-final 了; questions may end with (了)没有. (p. 68; PDF 88)
- **从** — `从 + starting point (+ 到 + endpoint)`: introduces a time, route, process, or sequence starting point. (p. 69; PDF 89)
- **第** — `第 + numeral + classifier`: marks an ordinal or position in a sequence. (p. 69; PDF 89)

## Chapter 10

- **不要……了 / 别……了** — `不要 / 别 + verb phrase + 了`: discourages or forbids an action, often asking that it stop. (p. 76; PDF 96)
- **对** — `对 + person / thing + predicate`: introduces the target of an attitude, effect, or relation. (p. 76; PDF 96)

## Chapter 11

- **Verb phrase as attributive** — `verb / verb phrase + 的 + noun`: 的 links a verbal modifier to the noun it describes. (p. 84; PDF 104)
- **比 comparison** — `A + 比 + B + adjective`; `A + 没有 + B + adjective` gives the negative comparison. Difference phrases can specify the gap. (pp. 84–85; PDF 104–105)
- **可能** — `可能 + verb phrase` or `可能 + subject + predicate`: marks a possibility or estimate. (p. 85; PDF 105)

## Chapter 12

- **Degree complements** — `verb (+ repeated verb/object) + 得 + degree phrase`: describes the degree of an action or state. With an object, place it before the verb or repeat the verb; negation follows 得. (pp. 92–93; PDF 112–113)
- **比 with degree complements** — `A + 比 + B + verb + 得 + complement` or `A + verb + 得 + 比 + B + complement`: 比 may precede the verb or the complement. (p. 93; PDF 113)

## Chapter 13

- **着** — `verb + 着`: marks a continuing state. Negation places 没 before the verb; a yes-no question may end with 没有. (p. 100; PDF 120)
- **不是……吗 rhetorical question** — `不是 + proposition + 吗?`: reminds the listener or expresses confusion or dissatisfaction. (p. 101; PDF 121)
- **往** — `往 + direction / place`: introduces a direction of movement. (p. 101; PDF 121)

## Chapter 14

- **过 experience** — `verb + 过`: marks a past experience not presented as continuing to the present. Negation uses 没(有) before the verb; questions may end with 没有. (p. 108; PDF 128)
- **虽然……但是……** — Links clauses in a concessive or adversative relation. (pp. 108–109; PDF 128–129)
- **Frequency complement 次** — `verb (+ 过) + number + 次 + object`: counts occurrences. With a place object, 次 may come before or after the place. (p. 109; PDF 129)

## Chapter 15

- **要……了, imminent action** — `快要 / 快 / 就要 / 要 + verb phrase + 了`: says an event is about to happen. With an explicit time expression, use 就要……了. (p. 116; PDF 136)
- **都……了** — `都 + time / amount / situation + 了`: means already and often adds emphasis or impatience. (p. 116; PDF 136)
